disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源码与配置中是否存在 API Key、私钥、云凭据、钱包助记词等敏感信息的读取或硬编码，未发现任何凭据处理代码；行情数据全部来自无鉴权公开接口，插件明确声明不读取或存储第三方行情凭据。
checked_items.en: Reviewed all source code and configuration for reading or hardcoding of sensitive information such as API keys, private keys, cloud credentials, and wallet mnemonics; no credential-handling code was found. Market data comes entirely from unauthenticated public endpoints, and the plugin explicitly declares that it does not read or store third-party market credentials.

checked_items.zh: 核对了客户端与服务端对本地存储、剪贴板、主机凭据接口的调用面，仅发现侧栏界面状态写入浏览器本地存储（保存界面开关状态），未发现对主机凭据文件的任何访问。
checked_items.en: Cross-checked the client-side and server-side call surfaces for local storage, clipboard, and host credential interfaces. Only sidebar UI state writes to browser local storage (saving UI toggle states). No access to host credential files was found.

evidence.zh: 未发现读取本地凭据文件或敏感路径的代码；网络外联目标全部为公开行情站点，凭据读取与外联组合不成立。
evidence.en: No code reading local credential files or sensitive paths was found. All network outbound targets are public market sites. The combination of credential reading and outbound connections is not present.

checked_items.zh: 逐一审查了 9 个股票工具对模型可见的描述文本，内容均为行情查询功能说明，未发现系统指令、凭据诱导、权限变更或安装引导类措辞。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the model-visible description text of all 9 stock tools one by one. The content is purely market query feature descriptions. No wording inducing system instructions, credential extraction, permission changes, or installation guidance was found.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了 README、配置、说明文档与代码注释，未发现伪装系统消息、指令覆写、远程指令拉取或隐藏指令文本；仓库中不存在 AGENTS/SKILL/CLAUDE 等模型指令文件，也无 MCP 或编辑器自动化配置。
checked_items.en: Scanned README, configuration, documentation, and code comments. No disguised system messages, instruction overrides, remote instruction fetching, or hidden instruction text were found. The repository contains no model instruction files such as AGENTS/SKILL/CLAUDE, nor any MCP or editor automation configuration.

evidence.zh: 9 个工具的描述文本均为行情查询功能说明，未含系统指令、权限操纵或凭证诱导内容；未发现向系统提示注入文本段落的调用。
evidence.en: The description text of all 9 tools is purely market query feature descriptions, without system instructions, permission manipulation, or credential-induced content. No calls injecting text into the system prompt were found.

evidence.zh: 工具描述与 README 中无诱导模型执行安装命令、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；安装说明为常规的 dsh 插件添加命令文档。
evidence.en: Tool descriptions and README contain no wording inducing the model to execute installation commands, rewrite configuration, or relax permissions. The installation instructions are standard documentation for the dsh plugin add command.

checked_items.zh: 审查了挂载配置（cordis.patch.yml），仅含一条资源插入声明，不存在可执行脚本标签或动态求值内容；全库运行时代码未发现动态求值或函数构造类执行调用。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the patch config (cordis.patch.yml). It contains only one resource insertion declaration, with no executable script tags or dynamic evaluation content. No dynamic evaluation or function-constructor-style execution calls were found in the entire runtime codebase.

checked_items.zh: 检查了安装与生命周期脚本：包发布清单不含任何安装钩子；两个构建脚本使用系统子进程命令执行编译与打包，但仅存在于开发者仓库、不随发布产物分发，不会在用户安装或运行时执行，判定为良性开发工具。
checked_items.en: Checked install and lifecycle scripts: the package publish manifest contains no install hooks. Two build scripts use system subprocess commands to compile and package, but they exist only in the developer repository and are not distributed with the release artifact, so they do not execute during user installation or runtime. These are judged as benign developer tools.

checked_items.zh: 检查了浏览器端模块：注册行情侧栏、设置卡片等界面组件，未发现键盘监听、剪贴板读取、主机特权接口调用或远端载荷下载执行行为。
checked_items.en: Checked the browser-side modules: they register UI components such as the market sidebar and settings card. No keyboard listeners, clipboard reads, host privileged interface calls, or remote payload download-and-execute behavior were found.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置不含可执行脚本标签（无 js 标量类写法），不存在通过配置求值执行代码的面。
evidence.en: The patch config contains no executable script tags (no JS scalar-style syntax), so there is no surface for executing code through configuration evaluation.

evidence.zh: 源码中未发现调用宿主动态执行工具（如 cordis_define/cordis_run 类）的任何引用。
evidence.en: No references in the source code to host dynamic execution tools (such as cordis_define/cordis_run) were found.

evidence.zh: 包无安装钩子；构建脚本中的子进程调用仅存在于开发者仓库（发布清单不含脚本目录），不会在用户安装或运行时执行；无隐藏下载执行类载体。
evidence.en: The package has no install hooks. Subprocess calls in build scripts exist only in the developer repository (the publish manifest does not include the scripts directory) and do not execute during user installation or runtime. No hidden download-and-execute payload carrier exists.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了浏览器端模块；审查客户端代码未发现键盘监听、剪贴板读取或调用主机凭据接口的 RPC，仅注册行情侧栏与设置界面，RPC 仅访问插件自有的行情数据与配置通道。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a browser-side module. Review of the client code found no RPC for keyboard listeners, clipboard reads, or calls to host credential interfaces. Only the market sidebar and settings UI are registered. RPC only accesses the plugin's own market data and configuration channels.

checked_items.zh: 枚举了全部外联目标：行情请求只发往东方财富、腾讯、新浪、同花顺四家公开行情站点的固定接口（含少量备用域名），与插件声明的股票数据业务一致，未发现未知域名、裸 IP 或隧道类外发通道。
checked_items.en: Enumerated all outbound targets: market requests go only to fixed endpoints on four public market sites—East Money, Tencent, Sina, and Flush (with a few backup domains)—consistent with the plugin's declared stock data business. No unknown domains, raw IPs, or tunnel-style exfiltration channels were found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了数据变换与外发链路，未发现读取敏感数据后再编码或压缩外发的组合；所有请求仅携带查询参数与固定来源标识，不携带任何用户数据或凭据。
checked_items.en: Checked data transformation and exfiltration chains. No combination of reading sensitive data followed by encoding or compressing it for exfiltration was found. All requests carry only query parameters and a fixed source identifier, with no user data or credentials.

evidence.zh: 外联域名清单已完整枚举（东方财富、腾讯、新浪、同花顺公开接口），与声明业务一致，无未声明端点；无编码变换后外发链路。
evidence.en: The outbound domain list has been fully enumerated (East Money, Tencent, Sina, and Flush public endpoints), consistent with the declared business. No undeclared endpoints exist. There is no encode-transform-exfiltrate chain.

checked_items.zh: 核对依赖清单：仅依赖宿主 SDK、React 等常规包，未发现名称仿冒或与生态命名撞车的可疑依赖；发布清单仅包含编译产物、挂载配置与文档，不含源码、脚本、测试目录。
checked_items.en: Cross-checked the dependency manifest: only the host SDK, React, and other routine packages are depended on. No suspicious dependencies with name impersonation or naming collisions within the ecosystem were found. The publish manifest contains only compiled artifacts, the patch config, and documentation—no source code, scripts, or test directories.

checked_items.zh: 检查了挂载配置是否触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置：未发现禁用安全行、环境变量降权或改写服务注入的配置；包无安装钩子。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the patch config touches sandbox, approval, permission, or other security settings. No configuration disabling security lines, downgrading environment variables, or rewriting service injection was found. The package has no install hooks.

checked_items.zh: 首版审计无版本基线可对比，升级自动激活与历史改写信号无法判定（不适用），不构成风险信号。
checked_items.en: This is the first-version audit with no baseline version for comparison. Upgrade auto-activation and history-rewriting signals cannot be determined (not applicable) and do not constitute a risk signal.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置仅插入资源声明，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，无禁用或降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch config only inserts resource declarations and does not touch security setting lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions. There is no disablement or downgrade syntax.

evidence.zh: 插件对工具执行前事件使用普通监听并调用放行回调（不截断后续处理链），另注册了工具守卫用于会话级开关，均为对自有工具访问控制，未发现短路审批链的监听。
evidence.en: The plugin uses ordinary listeners for pre-tool-execution events and calls pass-through callbacks (without truncating the subsequent processing chain). It also registers a tool guard for session-level toggles. These are both access controls for its own tools. No listeners short-circuiting the approval chain were found.

evidence.zh: 首版审计，无上一版本基线可比较，升级自动激活场景不适用。
evidence.en: First-version audit with no previous baseline for comparison. The upgrade auto-activation scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写服务注入或拦截配置。
evidence.en: The patch config does not rewrite service injection or interception settings.

checked_items.zh: 检查插件是否自行启动 Web 服务或监听端口：未发现相关代码，插件复用宿主提供的 RPC 通道与工具注册机制，未引入新的本机网络服务面；动态沙箱未启用，运行时行为以静态分析结论为准。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts its own web service or listens on a port: no such code was found. The plugin reuses the host-provided RPC channel and tool registration mechanism, introducing no new local network service surface. Dynamic sandboxing was not enabled; runtime behavior is based on static analysis conclusions.

evidence.zh: 插件未启动 Web 服务或监听端口，本机无认证 RPC 场景不适用；插件仅复用宿主的 RPC 通道与工具注册机制，未新增本机网络服务面。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a web service or listen on a port, so the unauthenticated local RPC scenario is not applicable. The plugin only reuses the host's RPC channel and tool registration mechanism and does not add a local network service surface.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份校验通过：插件正确声明 dsh 接入面（bundle 挂载配置与客户端模块），挂载配置内容良性，无名称仿冒或身份风险。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: the plugin correctly declares the dsh integration surface (bundle patch config and client module), the patch config content is benign, and no name impersonation or identity risks were found.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成：3 条机械命中均判定为良性（构建脚本子进程调用属开发者工具、超长行属生成的数据目录），未发现危险执行、凭据处理或未知外联。
summary.en: Static scan completed: all 3 mechanical hits were judged benign (build script subprocess calls are developer tools; the overlong line belongs to a generated data directory). No dangerous execution, credential handling, or unknown outbound connections were found.

summary.zh: 行为分析完成：无安装钩子、无混淆载荷、无敏感路径读取，外联目标全部为公开行情站点。
summary.en: Behavior analysis completed: no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no sensitive path reads, and all outbound targets are public market sites.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查通过：工具描述与文档未发现提示词注入、能力虚报或诱导性内容。
summary.en: AI metadata review passed: no prompt injection, capability overstatement, or induced content was found in tool descriptions and documentation.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（本次运行未提供动态观测产物）。
summary.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed (no dynamic observation artifacts were provided in this run).

limits.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无动态观测产物）。插件未在 package.json 中显式声明能力清单，declared_capabilities 由代码实测推断（联网拉取公开行情、注册模型可见工具，无 shell/文件系统能力）；插件未声明 engines.dsh，按 peerDependencies 推断目标宿主 SDK 版本 0.0.1-rc.5，兼容性未经动态矩阵验证。机械扫描 3 条命中均已人工裁决为良性并排除：DSH-X03（构建脚本 scripts/build.mjs:3 与 scripts/verify-package.mjs:4 使用子进程命令编译打包，属开发者构建工具、不随发布分发，不构成发现）与 DSH-X08（src/stock-api/catalog.generated.ts:4 超长行是生成脚本产物的静态数据目录，非混淆载荷，不构成发现），对应规则 DG-R3-55 / DG-R3-60 均不产生 finding。
limits.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed (no dynamic observation artifacts). The plugin does not explicitly declare a capability manifest in package.json; declared_capabilities was inferred from code measurements (network fetch of public market data, registration of model-visible tools; no shell or filesystem capability). The plugin does not declare engines.dsh; the target host SDK version 0.0.1-rc.5 was inferred from peerDependencies, and compatibility was not verified through a dynamic matrix. All 3 mechanical scan hits were manually adjudicated as benign and excluded: DSH-X03 (build scripts scripts/build.mjs:3 and scripts/verify-package.mjs:4 use subprocess commands to compile and package, which are developer build tools not distributed with the release, so they do not constitute a finding) and DSH-X08 (the overlong line at src/stock-api/catalog.generated.ts:4 is a static data directory produced by a generated script, not an obfuscated payload, so it does not constitute a finding). Corresponding rules DG-R3-55 / DG-R3-60 produce no findings.
